sources.location: off-white walls, linen, speckled oat glaze
kraft tag with handwritten batch number
serif name, thin clay-colored rule, charcoal text on off-white

meta.summary: A care card on linen by a north window: off-white paper, charcoal text, a light serif, and clay only on small type and thin rules. Lots of empty space. Fonts: Cormorant Garamond (wordmark, headings), Inter (body, labels).

concept: A care card on linen by a north window. Off-white paper, charcoal type, one thin clay-colored line, and room around everything.

paper.name: Studio white
paper.role: Main background, like the studio wall and the care card.
paper.rule: Paper covers most of every post. Empty space is part of the look: leave at least a third of the canvas with nothing in it.

charcoal.name: Kiln charcoal
charcoal.rule: All type is charcoal (12.7:1 on paper), except one small clay label.

stone.name: Stone gray
stone.role: Secondary text: attributions, small labels, the second line of a lockup.
stone.rule: 4.8:1 on paper. For small supporting text only, never headings.

clay.name: Raw clay
clay.role: A thin rule, a tag number, a price label.
clay.rule: One clay element per post, and small: 3.4:1 on paper, so only type 40px and up or a hairline rule. It's the bare clay at the rim, not a paint color.

avoid.reason: Paper text on a clay fill turns the accent into a button and fails contrast for small type.
Clay on charcoal goes muddy. Keep the background paper.

roles.note: Maps the shared post templates' color roles to this brand's colors. Templates only ever use roles, so the same layout works for every brand.
roles.heading: charcoal
roles.label: paper

material_notes: The glaze color in photos varies by batch and by light. Never recolor a photo to match the palette.
North light is cool and even. Don't warm photos up; the paper hex is for type backgrounds, not a grade.

wordmark.description: A light, high-contrast serif: 'Hollis' over a small, widely spaced WARE, like the care card.
wordmark.rule: Quiet and small. The spaced WARE keeps it a mark, not a headline.

heading.description: Light serif in sentence case, set large with plenty of air. Never bold, never all caps.

body.description: A neutral sans for facts: material, count, price, release time.
body.rule: Set facts the way the tag does: short, with middle dots between them.

hand.description: Not handwriting: a small spaced-out label in Inter, like a batch number on a shelf.
hand.rule: At most one label per post: the batch and number, or the price. The brand has no handwriting font; the only handwriting is on the real tags in photos.

shape.rule: Square corners, nothing rotated. Calm comes from alignment and space.
